subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should maintainers keep this draft as the combined Telegram proof target until Mantis actually exercises the generated-media marker path, or retire it in favor of the split PRs?
rationale: The branch is intentionally proof-only and combines two open landing boundaries; automation cannot decide whether skipped proof is enough or whether the stack should be merged, kept, or closed.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Combined Boundary
options.body: Merge the stack only if maintainers intentionally want the implementation, proof harness, and stack-only alignment commit to land together.

options.title: Retire The Stack
options.body: Close this draft if the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario or if the split PRs no longer need a combined proof target.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is mainly about the Telegram proof runner and proof artifact path, where vincentkoc has recent directly relevant commits.
